justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly identified the initial appointment time but failed to understand the recurring nature of the request, repeatedly checking for single slots instead of a series.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeatedly checked for single appointment slots at the same time and day, despite the user's clear request for a recurring series, leading to multiple unnecessary turns.

overall_notes: The agent struggled with the concept of a recurring appointment series, leading to a frustrating experience for the user who had to re-state their request multiple times.
